sloka: इणेयम् श्रपयस्वैतच्च्चालाम् यक्ष्यमहे वयम् ।त्वरसौम्य मुहूर्तोऽयम् ध्रुवश्च दिवसोऽप्ययम् ॥२-५६-२५॥
transliteration: iṇeyam śrapayasvaitacccālām yakṣyamahe vayam ।tvarasaumya muhūrto'yam dhruvaśca divaso'pyayam ॥2-56-25॥

translations.english: Cook this venison, O handsome one We will offer it to the presiding deity of this hut. Hasten, the day and time are fixed (for the rites)
